content:
nina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands around pricing/usage: a few customers asked for clear language we can point to on credits vs quotas vs reserved capacity. can we capture the canonical blurb here?
omar: Canonical short form: credits = prepaid units applied to Hosted usage; quotas = enforced limits (requests/min, tokens/day) on any plan; reserved capacity = Dedicated pools purchased as throughput commitments.
kevin: A few nitty-gritty questions that came up: 1) Are trial credits refundable or roll over? 2) Can Hosted traffic 'burst' above quota? 3) How does prioritization work under pressure?
leah: Answers: 1) Trial credits expire at trial end (no auto-rollover). Refunds only per contract on enterprise deals. 2) Hosted supports short, limited bursts if cluster headroom exists; bursts are bounded by tiered ceilings and safety limits. 3) Dedicated pools have allocation guarantees; Hosted traffic is scheduled by org priority + headroom and may be rerouted to fallbacks or rate-limited when constrained.
nina: For the burst behavior: can we give concrete examples (numbers) for the one-pager so Support/Sales can use them?
kevin: Example (illustrative, subject to change): Dev tier trial = 50k tokens / 1h burst ceiling = 10k tokens / 1min; Growth tier = 250k tokens / 5min; Enterprise = negotiable. We'll put an explicit table in the doc.
leah: Important operational detail: we never preempt in-flight requests. If capacity is constrained we either queue, throttle, or fallback to a compatible smaller model. preemption of running prompts is avoided.
ops-bot: infra-update: quota-alerting set to trigger at 80% and 95% for org token windows; new dashboard panel added.
sales-bot: request: can the public usage API include a short "human summary" field we can surface in our app (eg: "You have 12% of trial credits remaining")?
omar: Yes, public endpoint planned: GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/usage will return counters, credit balance, active rate limits, and quota windows. We'll add an SDK helper for a concise summary.
kevin: Billing nuance: prepaid hosted credits are consumed prior to invoiced usage and are not refundable under self-serve terms. Enterprise contracts can specify different handling.
nina: Can someone assemble a one-pager + FAQ bullets with trial defaults, rollover policy, bursting rules, and the API link? Sales & Support want it asap.
leah: I'll draft the FAQ + a quick diagram of routing/fallback behavior. Kevin, Omar: can you verify the example burst numbers?
kevin: I'll validate numbers with infra and post updates by EOD.
omar: I'll draft the canonical paragraph and a short Q&A list, will open a docs PR.
dev-bot: note: created GH issue #4382 "docs: pricing/credits FAQ + usage API examples" assigned to omar and leah.
